title: CustomersCustomerRegisteredPayload
description: Payload of `customers.customer.registered` version 1: a customer account was opened, a registration completed. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`, because a customer is not scoped to a partner. The payload carries no phone number, email address or address. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

entry.description: What the registration served: the delivery storefront, a pickup, or a table code scanned for dine-in.

channel.description: How the customer signed up: a one-time code to the number.

new_user.description: Whether the user was created by this registration; `false` for a person who already held a membership, such as a Partner owner who shops or an Agent who orders lunch.
